description_en: Queries the servers on which the anti-ransomware client is installed in a specified region
description_zh: 查询指定地域下已安装防勒索客户端的服务器
name: DescribeBackupClients

parameters.help_en: The region supported by the anti-ransomware feature to query. You can call the [DescribeSupportRegion](~~DescribeSupportRegion~~) operation to query the regions supported by the anti-ransomware feature
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的防勒索支持的地域。您可以调用[DescribeSupportRegion](~~DescribeSupportRegion~~)查询防勒索支持的地域
parameters.name: support_region_id

schema.description_en: The returned data of the servers on which the anti-ransomware client is installed
schema.description_zh: 已安装防勒索客户端的服务器返回数据

Clients.description_en:
The information about the anti-ransomware clients.
An empty list indicates that the current account has no anti-ransomware backup client records. The client information is synchronized by Security Center from the Hybrid Backup Recovery (HBR) service. If the anti-ransomware feature is not activated or the anti-ransomware client is not installed on the server, this field returns an empty array
Clients.description_zh:
防勒索客户端信息。
该列表为空表示当前账号暂无防勒索备份客户端记录。客户端信息由云安全中心从云备份（HBR）服务同步，未开通防勒索或服务器未安装防勒索客户端时，该字段返回空数组

items.description_en: The information about the server on which the anti-ransomware client is installed
items.description_zh: 安装防勒索客户端的服务器信息

ClientId.description_en: The ID of the anti-ransomware client

ClientStatus.description_en:
The status of the anti-ransomware client. Valid values:
INSTALLING: The client is being installed.
ONLINE: The client is online.
UNINSTALLING: The client is being uninstalled.
NOT_INSTALLED: The client is not installed.
ACTIVATED: The client is activated.
CLIENT_CONNECTION_ERROR: A client connection error occurred
ClientStatus.description_zh:
防勒索客户端的状态。

取值：

INSTALLING：客户端安装中

ONLINE：正常在线

UNINSTALLING：客户端卸载中

NOT_INSTALLED：客户端未安装

ACTIVATED：客户端已启用

CLIENT_CONNECTION_ERROR：客户端连接错误

ClientVersion.description_en: The version number of the anti-ransomware client

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the ECS instance on which the anti-ransomware client is installed
InstanceId.description_zh: 已安装防勒索客户端的ECS服务器的实例ID

Uuid.description_en: The UUID of the ECS instance on which the anti-ransomware client is installed
Uuid.description_zh: 已安装防勒索客户端的ECS服务器的UUID

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
